notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Localization Update
notes.content:
Hello, detectives of Farca!

We've just integrated a new update into the game’s system. The improvements to the simplified Chinese language pack have been successfully added to the Song of Farca, enhancing your gaming experience! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259236/fd2fe48fcb874025a09f08363d5622650fe15703.png[/img]

This localization adjustment mainly contains the fixed versions of incorrect translations. Additionally, we've invested time to ensure that the Chinese language text in the game is more lifelike and natural for Chinese speakers. 

Stay sharp in your investigation! 💻 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435670/Song_of_Farca/

notes.title: Chinese Localization Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've just released a long-awaited language update for Song of Farca. The game is now available in simplified Chinese. We've spent a lot of time working on and testing the translation, and we hope our Chinese players like the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259236/0f58ee4c93c278df8c5d857a3ef3961b66aafc1a.png[/img]

Thank you for your time and patience! And thank you to everyone who cares about the game and everyone who left reviews – you help us make the game better!

tags.feature: The game is now available in simplified Chinese.

notes.title: New patch is now available!
notes.content:
New Song of Farca patch is now available!

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when some of the choice consequences were not updating correctly on subsequent playthroughs, blocking some players from earning achievements
[*] Fixed several issues blocking players from progressing through locations
[*] FPS should now be locked to 60, drastically reducing GPU load
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/ABSjUU54tA 💙

notes.title: Hotfix is now available!
notes.content:
First Song of Farca hotfix is now available! 

List of changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with objects disappearing from robot's inventory
[*] Fixed an issue with some internet profiles not being updated after collecting clues
[*] Fixed an issue of displaying the scrollbar in dialogs
[*] Fixed an issue with the counter for collecting evidence work in some locations
[*] Fixed dog sleep animation in some places
[*] Fixed bug bots and drones getting stuck for some players
[*] Fixed safes opening without a code
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/ABSjUU54tA 💙
